&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;">Fifteenth
Stratagem</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b><br /></b></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">调虎离山</span></span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">(diào
hǔ lí shān)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: x-large;"><i>Lure
the Tiger Out of the Mountains</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Never
openly attack an opponent who holds an advantageous position, but
instead lure him away from it, cutting him off from his source of
strength.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">An
example is how General Xu You (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">许攸</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
died 204) of Eastern Han (25-220 A.D.) suppressed an insurgency
carried out by Qiang people from the north. When the Qiang revolted
against the court, and Xu You was ordered to stop them, he first
advanced on them at the gorge of Xiao Mountain. The Qiang, </span>
</p>
<p class="western" style="break-before: page; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; page-break-before: always; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">however,
were able to block this advancement, and the general, knowing the
situation to be disadvantageous, made an early retreat from the
gorge, and set up at a distance. He then began sending messengers to
ask for reinforcements from the capital at Luoyang. As the Qiang
people expected there would be no immediate attack, they grew remiss,
and some of the their detachments began leaving the gorge to plunder
local villages. At the right moment, Xu You marched his forces toward
the gorge, and as his army approached, he had them light additional
fires to give the impression that they were coming with
reinforcements. The remnants of the Qiang people still in the gorge
were terrified and dared not to engage them, and let them right
through.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Lure
the Tiger Out of the Mountains</i> is associated both with the 39th
and 40th hexagrams. The 39th hexagram, <i>Water over Mountain</i>,
represents something difficult to cross. In terms of military
strategy this can mean a heavily fortified position held by an
opponent. The yang line in the third position from the bottom aspires
to be in the fifth already-filled position. This line therefore
returns to own position and attempts to lure the enemy out from its
own superior position.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">The
40th hexagram, <i>Thunder over Water</i>, represents movement over
danger, i.e., a situation where danger has already passed, like the
quiet after a storm. The yang line which, before, was in the third
position, has moved back into the second position, and that which was
in the fifth position, "the tiger", has been lured down
into the weaker fourth position [1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>


</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>VOCAB LIST 15:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"></span>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section67" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那一串钥匙在哪？</span></span></span></span></p>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我把那一把钥匙放到桌子上了。</span></span></span></p>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他认真地组织了这个活动。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">他的老板离开后，他也被调离了那个城</span></span>
    <span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;市。</span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">5)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">那里有一只老虎。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个游戏的规则很复杂。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请别弄坏共用的电脑。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的名字有没有一些特别的意思？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">吃天然的东西很重要。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我想告诉你一个秘密。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她醒了吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请再给我一杯水。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们再一次去了图书馆。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个问题很简单，请回答。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我同意，我们不应该依靠他们。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我很喜欢那一本书《战争与和平》。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">1</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">7</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">我妈妈让我整理房间。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>
